differences: Experiment 6: the Methods give 21 analysed participants (27 recruited, 6 excluded); the deposit's multi-day learning file has 20, matching the denominator df of the Results (F(1,19) and F(3,57) imply 20). The cause of the difference of one participant was not found.
Experiment 6: the Results print the Day x path distance interaction as F(1,19) = 19.74; the converted rows give F = 19.74 with df (3,57) (as for path distance), so the printed df look like a typo.

Experiment 1: the Methods say each stimulus was shown at least 125 times; the highest iteration number of a stimulus in the deposit is 104-127 (median 126), and 9 of 40 participants stay below 125 on some stimulus (Experiment 2: 10 of 33; lowest 124). The deposit's counter was not checked against the authors' raw files.
The forced-response error analyses, the model comparisons (BIC) and the mixed-model fits of the Results were not reproduced; they need smoothing and model code from the authors.
